name: element-legacy
description: Community-maintained Element UI 2.x components for Vue 2.
author: Element Legacy Maintainers

scripts.build:file: element-legacy-build icon-init & element-legacy-build i18n & element-legacy-build version
scripts.build:theme: element-legacy-build gen-cssfile && pnpm --filter @element-legacy/theme-chalk run build && element-legacy-build cp ../theme-chalk/lib lib/theme-chalk && element-legacy-build cp ../theme-chalk/lib theme-chalk/lib && element-legacy-build cp ../theme-chalk/src theme-chalk/src
scripts.clean: rimraf lib && rimraf packages/*/lib && rimraf test/**/coverage
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:file && npm run lint && npm run build:lib && npm run build:theme
